name: timeline-gantt
title: Timeline gantt
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Workstream Gantt with task bars, dependency curves, a today marker, and a sticky scale. Hover opens a detail card.

meta.descriptionEs: Barras por frente, dependencias, línea de hoy y una tarjeta al pasar el puntero. La escala se queda fija.

examples.title: Taller Bruma
examples.description: Semana, mes o día. Datos inventados. Nada se guarda.

examples.title: Marco de estrés
examples.description: 320px, vacío, carga, error, token largo y cuarenta tareas.

meta.usage:
<TimelineGantt
  items={items}
  workstreams={workstreams}
  scale="week"
  now="2026-10-25T18:00:00.000Z"
  onSelect={(item) => open(item.id)}
  onHover={(item) => preview(item)}
/>

api.name: items / workstreams
api.description: Controlled records. TMeta is never read. deps are ids of other items.

api.name: scale / onScaleChange
api.description: Controlled or uncontrolled. The header stays sticky while the scale scrolls.

api.name: onSelect / onHover
api.description: A bar click selects. Hover and focus open the detail card and report the item.

api.name: now / locale / weekStartsOn
api.description: Default locale es-MX and Monday. now places the today line. Pass it in tests.

api.name: loading / error / disabled
api.description: Loading and error replace the grid. disabled keeps it visible and blocks the bars.

api.name: labels / className
api.description: Spanish chrome. timelineGanttLabelsEn is the English set.

docs: Clean-room schedule. Pass items with id, workstream, label, start, end, status, and optional deps. Dates are inclusive YYYY-MM-DD and the day is read in UTC. onSelect and onHover do not write the items. Arrow keys move between bars. The scale header stays pinned while the timeline scrolls sideways. The today line uses now, which should be a stable timestamp in tests. Reduced motion skips the bar fade. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite button, empty, skeleton, or tooltip-card. The item ships no theme. No mockup source, copy, colors, or assets were copied.
